description: Right hand with fingers pointing straight down (0-3.2 s), then a fist turned through several orientations, including pointed straight at the camera like a punch (3.3-18.9 s), then fingers pointing down again (19.1 s on, starting near the bottom edge). The whole middle stretch is a fist. Pointed at the camera, the knuckles hide the wrist, so in the image the knuckle-to-wrist distance shrinks to a quarter and 2D reach shot up to 4-18; from some angles MediaPipe also sees the index finger half uncurled, or flicking straight for two frames. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every frame (~50 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
